rules: A chat or worker is never repository authority by identity alone.
Mutation requires an active work lease bound to the current owner objective, owner control head, and exact current durable owner-lane claim.
owner_claim_id, owner_claim_epoch, executor_mode, owner_lane, objective_id and work_session_id must match the current durable owner-lane claim.
A boolean assertion that an owner lease is valid is insufficient; mutation authorization must validate the current claim identity and epoch.
candidate_branch must not be main or another canonical control ref.
base_sha and owner_control_head must be exact 40-character Git SHAs.
fence_epoch and owner_claim_epoch are positive integers and may never move backward.
The lease holder cannot widen allowed_paths, allowed_effects, owner_lane, objective_id, owner_claim_id, owner_claim_epoch or executor_mode.
The lease holder cannot mint or renew its own lease or owner-lane claim.
Cross-owner writes and central objective replacement require USER_REQUIRED authority.
Expired, superseded, revoked, stale-base, stale-control or stale-owner-claim leases fail closed for mutation.
Read-only inspection may continue after mutation authority is lost, but resulting knowledge must be revalidated before later writes.
